recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for the core reconciliation. No core follow-up is needed; any future wording or publication work for request-insurance should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack source.
issue_request: FHIR-32756 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked to replace the vague request-insurance description with wording explaining relevant Coverage use for eligibility checking, authorization, pre-determination, and claiming, plus ClaimResponse use for insurer responses to prior authorization or pre-determination requests.
initial_application: No current FHIR core source definition for request-insurance remains to change. The applied source change is in the FHIR Extension Pack: commit dbd06f60f9aee7d3cdd10fbd18eef92e39d5c560 changed input/definitions/NutritionOrder/StructureDefinition-request-insurance.xml from the old description to the approved Coverage/ClaimResponse wording in both StructureDefinition.description and the root Extension definition.
additional_context: Current core source only references the request-insurance canonical URL in source/oids.ini and has no active request-insurance profile or extension definition in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-I minutes for 2025-09-22 record changing the proposed resolution from NutritionOrder-specific wording to request-level wording because the extension has both NutritionOrder and CarePlan contexts.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. The authoritative extension definition is outside this core checkout and already contains the applied wording, so editing core would touch only an OID registry entry or stale historical material rather than the extension build source.

related_jiras.note: Published Extension Pack issue establishing CarePlan as an additional request-insurance context, which explains the final request-level wording.
Earlier request-pattern extension context issue mentioned in the Jira discussion as the reason the extension was originally attached to NutritionOrder/request-pattern resources.
